samir_csm: Quick heads-up / QBR for ClearWave next Mon 2pm PT. Finance flagged sudden embed spikes and wants a concrete mitigation + a runway slide. Who can own a 1-slide savings case and a short pilot plan?

helen_cs: I got the slide. I'll do status_quo vs optimized and a simple savings delta chart.

matt_se: I can pull top routes and estimate token reductions from prefix caching + small batching window. Note: their rerank job fans out to 3 calls, so dedupe could help.

monitor_bot: alert: account=clearwave daily_tokens=1.8M @2026-06-04T03:02:00Z — budget_alert issued, tagged #cs-escalations.

claire_fin: Renewal flagged as "watch". Projected spend (status_quo) ~ $4.2k/mo. If they accept 3mo small dedicated commit we can show ~15% unit-cost reduction. Need sensitivity chart.

helen_cs: Draft playbook for the slide: (1) immediate: enable prefix_kv on conversation routes + set soft alert at 1.3M/day; (2) 1 week: enable 200ms batching for bulk embed jobs; (3) 2-4 weeks: run quantized rerank pilot on mirror traffic; (4) A/B pilot: enable caching for 25% traffic for 3 days to prove savings.

matt_se: Snippet to include in appendix: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: /v1/chat/complete
    cache: prefix_kv
    cache_ttl: 1800
    batching:
      enabled: true
      max_delay_ms: 200
```

claire_fin: I'll prepare a two-scenario sensitivity table: status_quo and with-optimizations, plus credits-left runout days under each.

samir_csm: Action items: @helen_cs one-slide + chart by EOD tomorrow; @matt_se top-10 routes + savings estimate; @claire_fin sensitivity table and commit tiers; monitor_bot will post escalation if threshold recurs.

helen_cs: ack  will post slide link and CSV.

(ends)
